source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of DNA replication (PDF 123).

blocks.text: DNA replication woh amal hai jis mein DNA ka molecule apni bilkul aik jaisi copy (replica) banata hai. DNA double helix molecule hai (do strands se bana). Is liye woh apne dono strands ki copies banata hai.

blocks.title: Recalling (yaad karein):
blocks.text: Chromatids ka DNA replicate hota hai taa ke chromatids dugne (duplicate) ho saken. Yeh cell ke divide hone se pehle, yaani interphase ke S-phase mein, hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Cell cycle ke kis marhale mein DNA replicate hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Interphase ke S-phase mein, yaani cell divide hone se pehle.

items: Replication: DNA apne dono strands ki copy banata hai; yeh S-phase mein hoti hai.
